title: limonium sinuatum subvar. annuum
intro: Limonium sinuatum subvar. annuum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Yellow Sea Lavender, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Limonium sinuatum subvar. annuum include relaxing and calming the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting better sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
